name: Seated Hamstring And Calf Stretch
steps: Loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. Sit down with both legs extended . This will be your starting position.
Leaning forward slightly, pull on the belt to draw the toes of your foot back. Hold this position for 10-20 seconds and then repeat with the other leg.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout the entire range of motion
Avoid using momentum to complete repetitions
